trivia: The first two agent z Classics featured watermarks on the videos similar to Splatshorts, but these were removed following the third agent z Classic, 'Forming Teams in Eggstra Work Be Like...
There is a secret page on this website that is only accessible by typing a specific valid URL (agentzofficial.com/[secretText]). Hint, it's not that.
'agent z', the YouTube Channel entity, is the same as Agent W, Agent Z's computer in-universe.
Agent 8's participation in 'Battle of Inkopolis Square' was not in the original script, but due to fan speculations and expectations, it was added.
Agent X's favorite flower as seen in a Splatshort, the Gympie-Gympie, is one of the world's most venomous plants.
In 2025, 'The Perfect Present' and 'Library Thief' were the only episodes to not feature the main 5 characters, Agent 3 and Agent 8 in the former episode and Agent X in the latter.
Throughout the Power Trip Story Arc, flashbacks consistently did not have the character's name identify them in their dialogue, leaving many characters in Agent X and Agent Z's pasts unnamed.
Both Agent 3 and Agent 8 use the same model phone, being in the shape of an octopus.
